notes: All body-contact controls reproduce the old generator death and retain real hull danger.

An initial candidate run refused a loose audio request at the local HTTP accept queue; the final real static-server run uses backlog128 and reports no errors.

No full human campaign clear or hardware audio/haptics claim.
Separate local modular routing, spread, tutorial and launcher work remains unstaged and preserved.
